text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging matt_oncall for incidents channel — elevated 5xx and TLS handshake failures from prod-gateway (region: us-west-2). Severity: P1.

matt_oncall: on it. seeing alert graphs in console, spike started ~2278901200. any customer reports? :eyes:

sara_ops: yes, a few customers reported API failures and timeouts via support tickets, CS triage said ~10% of requests 5xx.

julie_sre: i'm seeing repeated `SSL3_GET_SERVER_CERTIFICATE:certificate verify failed` in the gateway logs. grabbing sample.

kevin_eng: paste the exact error logs? also check cert expiry dates. run `openssl s_client -connect gateway.prod.redwood:443 -showcerts`

julie_sre: log snippet: ```
2026-03-15T18:01:22Z gateway[worker-7]: tls: client handshake error: remote error: tls: handshake failure
2026-03-15T18:01:23Z gateway[worker-3]: verify error:num=10:certificate has expired
2026-03-15T18:01:23Z gateway[worker-3]: TLS handshake failed for connection from 34.201.12.45
```

matt_oncall: ran openssl, got: ```
$ openssl s_client -connect gateway.prod.redwood:443 -servername gateway.prod.redwood
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = gateway.prod.redwood
verify error:num=10:certificate has expired
notAfter=Mar 15 17:59:59 2026 GMT
---
```

sara_ops: confirmed expiry at 17:59:59 UTC — that matches spike. deploy-bot shows last cert rotation job ran 2d ago and reported success.

deploy-bot: last-rotation-job: job-id=rotator-20260313-09 status=SUCCESS details="uploaded cert bundle to s3://certs/prod/gateway/20260313.pem"

kevin_eng: hmm. maybe the active instance is still serving old cert from local cache. Can we reload gateway certs without full restart?

julie_sre: we have `gateway admin cert reload` endpoint. i'll trigger on one node to test.

julie_sre: `curl -X POST https://admin.gateway.internal/reload-cert -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"node":"worker-3"}'` -> response 200.

julie_sre: after reload on worker-3, logs show `certificate renewed in memory, old cert removed`. testing handshake against that node: `openssl s_client -connect 10.2.7.3:8443 -servername gateway.prod.redwood` -> OK, no verify error.

matt_oncall: good. what's the rollout plan? we need to avoid flip-flopping clients mid-request.

sara_ops: CS: prioritize top affected customers (acct-452, acct-998) for manual retries, inform them ETA.

kevin_eng: propose: 1) drain and reload cert on all gateway workers in a rolling fashion 2) enable temporary routing to eu-backup for new sessions in us-west until all nodes reloaded 3) monitor 5xx rate and rollback if spike increases.

julie_sre: starting rolling reload now. commands: ```
for node in worker-{1..12}; do
  ssh ops@$node "sudo /usr/local/bin/gateway admin reload-cert" || echo "reload failed $node"
  sleep 10
done
```

matt_oncall: i'm updating the incident page and setting status to "mitigating". notifying oncall rotation to standby. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: traffic-shift: route-policy=eu-fallback percent=20 duration=10m reason="mitigate us-west TLS failures"

cs_ana: sent note to impacted customers with recommended retry window 5mins, flagged account teams.

julie_sre: reload progress: worker-1..4 done, worker-5 failed with `permission denied` when invoking reload. investigating.

kevin_eng: if reload fails we can force restart process on worker-5 with zero-downtime by draining connections via proxy: ```
ssh ops@worker-5 "/usr/local/bin/gateway drain && sudo systemctl restart gateway && /usr/local/bin/gateway undrain"
```

julie_sre: did force restart on worker-5, now cert updated. continuing.

matt_oncall: observed 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 2% over last 8 minutes. nice.

sara_ops: support still seeing intermittent errors for long-lived clients doing TLS resumption (0-RTT) — some clients hold old session tickets referencing expired cert chain. any mitigation?

kevin_eng: we can invalidate session tickets at the gateway to force full renegotiation which picks up new certs. command: `gateway admin flush-session-tickets --region us-west`. Julie, can you run?

julie_sre: ran flush-session-tickets, logs: `flushed 124k tickets`. monitoring for client drop.

matt_oncall: after flush, I see additional transient spike in reconnects but 5xx continues downward to baseline ~0.8%. marking mitigation as effective.

deploy-bot: rotation-check: certs in s3 are valid and not expired; rotator job OK. postmortem action: add pre-rotation smoke test to verify active nodes picked up new cert within 5 minutes.

cs_ana: closing loop with customers — follow-up note drafted and queued.

matt_oncall: handing off to julie_sre for post-incident cleanup and postmortem. julie, you're on primary for writeup. :wave:

julie_sre: acknowledged. will collect logs, timeline, and remediation steps. tentative RCA: rotator uploaded cert but some gateway workers kept old cert in memory across rotation; missing smoke test to confirm in-memory reload. adding tasks: (a) enforce rotator to call `admin reload` after upload (b) add alert when cert `notAfter` within 24h and active node still serves expired cert (c) add automated session-ticket flush post-rotation.

matt_oncall: ETA for postmortem initial draft 2026-03-16 14:00 UTC. closing incident channel once writeup exists. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-15-2278901234 status: mitigated. Postmortem owner: julie_sre.
